pergunta: Encontre os documentos e nomes das estações de onde pelo menos 200 viagens começaram.
esperado: SELECT start_station_id, start_station_name FROM trip GROUP BY start_station_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 200
gerado:
```sql
SELECT DISTINCT t1.start_station_name, COUNT(*) AS num_trips
FROM trip t1
JOIN (
    SELECT start_station_id, COUNT(*) as count
    FROM trip
    GROUP BY start_station_id
) t2 ON t1.start_station_id = t2.start_station_id AND t1.start_station_name = t2.start_station_name
WHERE t2.count >= 200
GROUP BY t1.start_station_name
ORDER BY num_trips DESC;
